text:
emma (Design): Quick design check: proposing a small UX tweak for the scrubber/heatmap when ranges are sampled. Goal: reduce chip crowding, make sampling provenance obvious, and give a low-friction path to compute exact p95. Proto: https://redwood.design/mini/scrub-ux-2026 :link

raj (Frontend): Can you call out the constraints? Is this for side panels, dashboards, or mobile? Canvas perf is a concern if we add overlays.

emma (Design): Primary target: medium dashboard panels where p95 pill overlaps scrubber. Secondary: tablet and narrow dashboards. We want an inline, low-contrast affordance rather than a big warning.

kai (Observability): Context: for long ranges (>14d) we sample traces. Users often assume heatmap = full dataset. Backend can compute exact p95 but it's async/costly. We should expose sample ratio and an async "compute exact" CTA.

sam_ops: Backend constraints: POST /observability/compute-p95 -> {job_id, eta_seconds}. Recommended org rate-limit: 25/min. We'll cache full results for 10 minutes to avoid duplicates. Also can return a "cheap_estimate" that improves accuracy but is not exact.

maggie (A11y): Accessibility: color-only cues won't pass. Suggest: tiny textual chip "Sampled" plus a non-default pattern overlay in settings/high-contrast. Ensure chip has aria-label like "p95 130ms, estimated from a sample (ratio 1:10)" and the compute action announces via aria-live.

raj (Frontend): Proposed compact behavior: when width < 440px collapse p95 pill to an icon with an adjacent micro-chip that reads "Sampled" (or icon-only w/ aria-label). Clicking the chip opens a small popover with:
- sample ratio
- time range used
- button: "Compute exact p95" (async)
Keyboard: focus chip -> press S opens popover. Popover traps focus and uses aria-live to announce job queue/completion.

emma (Design): Microcopy options for the popover header — which feels clearer?
A) "Estimated from sampled traces"
B) "Showing estimates from a sample"

kai (Observability): Vote A. It's explicit and maps to telemetry. We'll tag events with variant=A|B for an experiment. Also include an example line in the popover: "Sampled 1:10  full compute ETA ~2m"

maggie (A11y): For the chip text, "Sampled" is short and scannable. But for screen readers the popover must show the full sentence e.g., "This p95 is estimated from 1 in 10 traces. You can request an exact computation which may take a few minutes."

ui-bot: Note: staging renderer v4 uses GPU canvas. Pattern overlays increased paint by ~5% on integrated GPUs. Consider SVG overlay only in high-contrast mode.

raj (Frontend): Implementation plan: default = color-only heatmap; patterns only when userSettings.highContrast == true or prefers-contrast: high. Use an SVG overlay for patterns to avoid double canvas draw. Chip tooltip text (short): "Estimated from sampled traces (1 in 10). Request exact p95." Button label: "Compute exact p95".

emma (Design): UX decisions for this sprint:
- compact chip labeled "Sampled" under 440px; full pill otherwise
- chip opens popover with ratio + CTA + short explanation (variant A copy)
- show sampling-density mini-bar under scrubber (visual cue) when available
- patterns: opt-in via high-contrast / user settings (SVG overlay)

sam_ops: I'll draft API spec + guardrails (job id, ETA, rate limits) and add telemetry fields: range_days, sample_ratio, variant, job_duration, p95_delta. Also add server-side caching 10m.

maggie (A11y): I'll create a quick checklist: color contrast, keyboard navigation, aria-live messages for job queued/completed, and screen reader phrasing. Will validate once prototype lands.

emma (Design): Nice. @raj can you put a small prototype in the thread by Tue? @sam_ops @maggie @kai please drop API/proposed messages. Leaving this open for microcopy tweaks. :sparkles:
